name: Costos y Eficiencia de Infraestructura
description: Costos k8s por scope/app/namespace/cuenta valuados contra blended rates mensuales (Finout amortizado + Datadog) y servicios con costo directo por recurso. Foco: eficiencia — uso real vs reserva.

elements.text:
##### Resumen del período
Promedios diarios sobre los días seleccionados. Eficiencia = uso real ÷ costo facturado (max(reserva, uso) × rate mensual).

##### Costo diario: uso real vs reserva ociosa
La banda roja es plata facturada por reservas que nadie usó — el objetivo es achicarla.

##### Top aplicaciones por waste
Las apps donde más plata se tira por sobre-reserva. USD por día promedio del período.

##### Detalle por scope
Ordenado por waste — candidatos a right-sizing (p95 de cores usados vs reservados).

##### Servicios (costo directo por recurso)
Redis y PostgreSQL gestionados, con su costo real de la factura.

kpi-costo.source: SELECT round(if(uniqExact(JSONExtractString(dj,'d'))=0,0,sum(JSONExtractFloat(dj,'cost_usd'))/uniqExact(JSONExtractString(dj,'d'))),0) AS costDay FROM customers_lake.catalog_entities AS e FINAL ARRAY JOIN JSONExtractArrayRaw(coalesce(e.data,''),'daily') AS dj WHERE e._deleted=0 AND e.entity_specification_id='9ea83047-5b8e-4110-b71e-d281fac5e40a' AND JSONExtractString(e.data,'id') LIKE 'scope-%' AND parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(JSONExtractString(dj,'d'))>=coalesce(parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({startDate:String}),now()-INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND (parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({endDate:String}) IS NULL OR parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(JSONExtractString(dj,'d'))<=parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({endDate:String})) AND ({app:String}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(e.data,'application_name'),{app:String})>0) AND ({ns:String}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(e.data,'namespace_name'),{ns:String})>0) AND ({acc:String}='' OR JSONExtractString(e.data,'account_name')={acc:String}) AND ({country:String}='' OR JSONExtractString(e.data,'dimensions','country')={country:String}) AND ({cloud:String}='' OR JSONExtractString(e.data,'dimensions','cloud')={cloud:String}) FORMAT JSON

round(if(uniqExact(JSONExtractString(dj,'d'))=0,0,(sum(JSONExtractFloat(dj,'cost_usd'))-sum(JSONExtractFloat(dj,'usage_usd')))/uniqExact(JSONExtractString(dj,'d'))),2) AS waste, round(if(sum(JSONExtractFloat(dj,'cost_usd'))=0,0,100*sum(JSONExtractFloat(dj,'usage_usd'))/sum(JSONExtractFloat(dj,'cost_usd'))),1) AS efic, e.entity_specification_id='9ea83047-5b8e-4110-b71e-d281fac5e40a' AND JSONExtractString(e.data,'id') LIKE 'scope-%' AND tabla-servicios.source: SELECT JSONExtractString(e.data,'entity_name') AS servicio, JSONExtractString(e.data,'infrastructure_reference','kind') AS tipo, coalesce(a.app_name,'') AS app, round(if(uniqExact(JSONExtractString(dj,'d'))=0,0,sum(JSONExtractFloat(dj,'cost_usd'))/uniqExact(JSONExtractString(dj,'d'))),2) AS costo FROM customers_lake.catalog_entities AS e FINAL LEFT JOIN customers_lake.core_entities_application AS a FINAL ON toString(a.app_id)=JSONExtractString(e.data,'application_id') AND a._deleted=0 ARRAY JOIN JSONExtractArrayRaw(coalesce(e.data,''),'daily') AS dj WHERE e._deleted=0 AND e.entity_specification_id='9ea83047-5b8e-4110-b71e-d281fac5e40a' AND JSONExtractString(e.data,'id') LIKE 'service-%' AND parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(JSONExtractString(dj,'d'))>=coalesce(parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({startDate:String}),now()-INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND (parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({endDate:String}) IS NULL OR parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(JSONExtractString(dj,'d'))<=parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({endDate:String})) AND ({app:String}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(a.app_name,''),{app:String})>0) AND ({ns:String}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(e.data,'namespace_name'),{ns:String})>0) AND ({acc:String}='' OR JSONExtractString(e.data,'account_name')={acc:String}) AND ({country:String}='' OR JSONExtractString(e.data,'dimensions','country')={country:String}) AND ({cloud:String}='' OR JSONExtractString(e.data,'dimensions','cloud')={cloud:String})  GROUP BY servicio, tipo, app ORDER BY costo DESC LIMIT 100 FORMAT JSON

filtro-cuentas.source: SELECT DISTINCT JSONExtractString(data,'account_name') AS id, JSONExtractString(data,'account_name') AS name FROM customers_lake.catalog_entities FINAL WHERE _deleted=0 AND entity_specification_id='9ea83047-5b8e-4110-b71e-d281fac5e40a' AND JSONExtractString(data,'account_name')!='' ORDER BY name FORMAT JSON
